reason: Built from the Sensirion SCD4x datasheet v1.5. The driver uses the SCD41-only single shot mode: 0x3F86 stop, then 0x219D with a 5000 ms wait, 0xE4B8 data-ready and 0xEC05 read, with a CRC-8 on every word. It discards the first reading after power-up, as the datasheet says to. Header order VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA is from Adafruit's pinouts guide, which says the SCD-40 and SCD-41 boards share one pinout, and from its Fritzing part. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico (simulator, breadboard, PCB DRC, footprint, LCSC).
